fields.statement: QA at 46f1cad8 with a -trimpath build, in a scratch root and repo with RHIZA_* and GOTMPDIR unset: a workflow with [env] GOTMPDIR={run_tmp}, NESTED={run_tmp}/sub, PLAIN=x ran with rhiza run start --foreground and succeeded; its command step saw GOTMPDIR=<repo>/.git/rhiza/runs/<run>/tmp (a directory while the step ran), NESTED=<that>/sub and PLAIN=x; its [[cleanup]] step saw the same GOTMPDIR with the folder still present; after the run the folder was gone. A workflow without [env] saw no GOTMPDIR. A workflow setting RHIZA_CHANGE in [env] fails rhiza workflow check with 'env: RHIZA_CHANGE is Rhiza's own variable and cannot be set'. go test ./internal/workflow/... ./internal/run/... and TestScripts/workflow-env pass.

QA at 46f1cad8 with a -trimpath build: rhiza workflow check passes for bugfix, plan-bug, docs, docs-build, docs-review and ship-change, and workflow describe bugfix and ship-change list the go-cleanup cleanup step. Ran .rhiza/workflows/go-cleanup.sh with GOCACHE and TMPDIR on a fake tree: it removed cache/0a/old-a (4h), tmp/go-build-old (3h), tmp/rhiza-old (3h) and tmp/rhiza-new (90m, over the hour); it kept cache/0a/mid-b (2h), cache/ff/new-c, cache/README and trim.txt (4h, top level), cache/zz/old-z (non-hex dir), tmp/go-build-mid (90m), tmp/other-old (3h, other prefix) and a 3h-old rhiza-file plain file; exit 0. With GOCACHE=off a 4h-old cache entry was left. In a scratch repo a workflow's [[cleanup]] step sees the [env] GOTMPDIR folder.

QA at 46f1cad8 with a -trimpath build: rhiza daemon settings lists no trimGoCache (0 matches for trim); rhiza docs --out into a scratch folder is identical to docs/reference, and config.md has no trimGoCache; outside internal/gosweep itself nothing in Go, scripts or docs names gosweep, trimGoCache, isRhizaRepo or EnvGoTmp. TestScripts/daemon-settings* pass.
